'''Charlie Alexander Villanueva''' is a [[basketball]] player at the [[University of Connecticut]]. He is a 6'11" [[small forward]], currently considering entering the [[NBA Draft]] after his sophomore season. Villanueva was born in [[Brooklyn]], [[New York]] on [[August 24]], [[1984]]. He attended high school at [[Blair Academy]], where he earned [[All-America]]n honors as a senior as well as [[New Jersey]] Co-player of the Year. He entered the NBA Draft but decided to withdraw his eligibility to attend college at [[UConn]]. In his first year at Connecticut, Villanueva was named to the [[Big East]] All-Rookie Team. In the Summer of [[2004]] Villanueva was a member of the gold medal-winning United States 21 and under team at the World Championships. He was also a member of the 2004 [[NCAA]] Men's Basketball National Champion [[University_Of_Connecticut|Connecticut Huskies]].
